They are also a great way to meet your peers, get to know the college, expand your college education beyond the classroom, and participate in student-sponsored social events on campus. Club hours are Thursdays from 12:45 - 2:15 p.m. (During the fall/spring terms) For information on Club meetings and events, check Check City Tech Connect .
